# ShramSafal

> For farmers who run farming like a business. Owning land is one thing. Building farming as an operation is another. ShramSafal brings direction, accounts, and responsibility to daily farm work.

ShramSafal is built by Agriryot Value Enterprises Private Limited (CIN U62099PN2026PTC256337), Maharashtra, India. The site is available in English and Marathi on the same URLs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shramsafal.in/): For farmers who run farming like a business.
- [Vision and Philosophy](https://shramsafal.in/vision): ShramSafal is built so daily farm effort does not disappear. It turns work into clarity, trust, and better decisions.
- [For Farmers and Farm Operators](https://shramsafal.in/farmers): Whether 10 guntha or 100 acres, farming needs clarity. See who ShramSafal is for and how daily work becomes visible.
- [Join the First Responsible Group](https://shramsafal.in/join): If daily farm work needs direction, accounts, observation, and responsibility, join the first responsible ShramSafal group.
- [Trust Is the Spine](https://shramsafal.in/privacy-trust): The one thing farming lacks most is trust. ShramSafal starts by helping farmers build trust from their real daily work.
